split.selection: B04 order from source center at attack commit; unique legal visible enemies except primary
split.hit: independent ordinary target checks; same launch R and source illusion factor; no primary-only native procs
split.events: one ATTACKED at ordinary attack start; independent B03 hero/NORMAL ranged attack packet per hit

engineering.basis: workbook H370/H511, only these two ANeg instances; Q24 lifecycle and contribution channels

glaive.Q48: confirmed: use this tower's own effective A052 level; no shared k001 gameplay contribution
glaive.selection: B04 after each completed hit, from impact-position snapshot, exclude the full visited set
glaive.raw: primary pre-mitigation (R*M)*f, multiplied by (1-loss)^hop; no primary-only B or damage-event results
glaive.flight: revalidate targets; misses stop chain; death of source preserves already launched chain, removal cancels
